_about: The national-direction question in the McKinnon Index. Satisfied and dissatisfied are the very/somewhat aggregates; neutral and don't know are separate answer categories. This differently worded house series is displayed separately and does not join the pooled right/wrong estimator.
question: All things considered, how satisfied are you with the way Australia is heading? 'Satisfied' aggregates very satisfied and somewhat satisfied; 'Dissatisfied' aggregates somewhat dissatisfied and very dissatisfied; neutral and don't know are separate answer categories.

waves.question: All things considered, how satisfied are you with the way Australia is heading?
waves.quote: Figure 11: Satisfied 28.8%; Neutral 15.4%; Dissatisfied 54.8%; Don't know 1.0% by residual. Methodology: 'The survey was conducted online with a large sample of n=4,416 Australians aged 18+ From the 9th –31st July 2025.'

waves.question: All things considered, how satisfied are you with the way Australia is heading?
waves.quote: Figure 03 of the key-findings report: Satisfied 26.1%, a 2.7-point fall. Dashboard: Very satisfied 3.5 + somewhat satisfied 22.6 = 26.1; Neither 14.1; Somewhat dissatisfied 26.5 + very dissatisfied 32.5 = 59.0; Don't know 0.9. The report methodology prints 4,273 Australians, online, 19 June to 21 July 2026.
